text:
mike: heads up — we're seeing exporter backlog and mem growth in python inference workers when spike of long requests hits. root span queue gets huge. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking_face:
sonia: yup. python batch exporter + asyncio + forked worker model is tricky. background thread holds references. we had to call force_flush before fork and during shutdown.
julia: for rust services it's different: tokio tasks hold exporter sender. when runtime is dropped exporter may not flush unless we await shutdown. have you tried bounded channel with drop-on-backpressure? reduces mem but loses spans.
kevin: important: don't create spans per token for streaming. one request span + `event` annotations for tokens. per-token spans explode cardinality and retention cost.
mike: agreed on tokens. but our infra uses per-token metrics now for throughput—tradeoffs. Also tenant-fanout exporter is causing per-request amplification (n tenants => n exports). need a better debounce.
julia: per-tenant fanout should be async and bounded. if tenant exporter is slow, upstream should sample/drop or route to cheaper sink. we used per-tenant buffer with LRU eviction of tenants.
sonia: Also consider sampling early in SDK init: make sampling decision before heavy work (model KV cache warmup) so we avoid allocating big baggage for unsampled traces.
kevin: propose shim: SDK init that sets Resource attrs, global sampler, and installs graceful drain hook for SIGTERM/SIGINT with a timeout. small pseudo:
```
# pseudocode
install_signal_handler(timeout=5s) {
  batch_exporter.force_flush(deadline=now+timeout)
  runtime.shutdown()
}
```

mike: can we standardize for Python/Go/Rust? go's signal + context cancel, python needs `atexit` + signal, rust needs `tokio::signal` await. want a cross-lang doc.
devex: please add a short console note about retention impacts of per-token spans and per-tenant fanout — customers ask about bill shock.
telemetry-bot: notice: recent ingest spike -> exporter queue depth high for `infer-prod` cluster at 2024-10-02T12:03Z. Suggest limiting span attributes (trim kvcache dump) and enabling sampling.
sonia: small config ideas: max_attributes=128, max_events=64, max_links=8, max_span_count per-request=1 (with events). also add per-service tracing flag `tracing.level=lite|full`.
julia: for rust we can compile a `lite` feature that strips expensive serde for span attrs. for go we can give a lighter wrapper that avoids golang map allocations on hot path.
kevin: next steps: PR with shim + per-tenant bounded fanout + doc for SDK init + console retention note. assign owners?
mike: i'll take python shim + doc. julia takes rust shim + perf test. kevin will prototype go handler + signal test. sonia will write sampling recommendations and retention doc. devex will draft console blurb.
devex: ack, will schedule short blurb + example screenshots for rollout page.
mike: thanks all :thumbsup: let's try to land before next prod deploy window.
